text: The purpose of this report is to present new Human Resources policies for the Board’s information and oversight.

The TO Live - Human Resources and Stakeholder Relations Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve Policies 232, 233 and 234, as detailed in Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (March 2, 2026) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live.
